title: Color-Grade-Transfer-LoRA for Precise Color Matching
summary: A specialized LoRA designed for high-fidelity automated color grading and palette alignment using reference images. It enables cinematic style transfer and consistent lighting across image sequences, optimized for the Qwen-Image-Edit architecture.
research_notes: Developed by ovi054 (Avi Pal); optimized for sub-second inference and high-fidelity 'reference-to-palette' matching.

evolution.summary: The project was recognized as a winner of the ModelScope LoRA training contest and subsequently became a core component of the Qwen-Image-Edit (QIE-2511) ecosystem. It now supports local inference applications and receives regular compatibility updates.
